units.source_text: 忠左卫门惊讶的看一眼藤左卫门。

en.t: Chuzaemon glanced at Tozaemon in surprise.

units.source_text: 不知道为什么，藤左卫门跟别人讲这个故事时，非常得意。

en.t: For some reason, Tozaemon was extremely pleased whenever he told this story to others.

units.source_text: “我刚才听说了差不多的两三件事，

en.t: I have just heard two or three rather similar incidents,

units.source_text: 其中最可笑的事是发生在南八丁堀的凑町中午的那件。

en.t: and the funniest of them was the one that happened at noon in Minatocho, in Minami Hatchobori.

units.source_text: 在公共澡堂里，附近米店的老板跟隔壁染房的伙计吵了起来，

en.t: In a public bathhouse, the owner of a nearby rice shop got into an argument with a young man from the dye shop next door,

units.source_text: 大概的缘故是染房伙计的洗澡水溅到了米店老板身上这种小事儿。

en.t: apparently over the trivial matter of bathwater from the dye shop worker splashing onto the rice shop owner.

units.source_text: 后来，染房伙计用水桶砸了米店老板，把他揍了一顿。

en.t: After that, the dye shop worker struck the rice shop owner with a water bucket and beat him up.

units.source_text: 后来米店的一个学徒为了给老板报仇，

en.t: Later, one of the rice shop's apprentices set out to avenge his master,

units.source_text: 傍晚时分，他在那伏击了染房伙计，用铁钩砍进了染房伙计的肩膀。

en.t: At dusk, he ambushed the dye shop worker there and slashed into his shoulder with an iron hook.

units.source_text: 据说他在砍人的时候还一边喊着‘我才是最厉害的，能给我的主人报仇雪恨’。

en.t: It is said that even as he struck, he shouted, 'I am the strongest; I can avenge my master.'
